title: Rethinking One-Shot Federated Graph Learning: Training-Free Statistical Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.06154v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One-shot federated graph learning generally aims to train Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) across clients with disconnected subgraphs in a single communication round. Existing methods predominantly design advanced optimization strategies under the premise that local GNN training is indispensable. However, empirical observations reveal that under extreme non-IID conditions, local GNN training suffers from severe cross-client representation misalignment, becoming a major source of error rather than a remedy. Motivated by this, we reformulate one-shot FGL as a statistical estimation problem. We propose SPEAR (Statistical Prototype Estimation with Adaptive Reliability), a completely training-free framework that directly computes topology-smoothed class prototypes from local graphs in the original feature space. The server then aggregates these prototypes using a sample-size-adaptive shrinkage estimator that down-weights unreliable local estimate

translated_title: 重新思考单轮联邦图学习：免训练的统计估计方法
translated_abstract: 单轮联邦图学习通常旨在通过单轮通信，在多个拥有互不相连子图的客户端上训练图神经网络（GNN）。现有方法主要基于“本地GNN训练不可或缺”这一前提来设计先进的优化策略。然而，实证观察表明，在极端非独立同分布条件下，本地GNN训练会产生严重的跨客户端表示不对齐问题，成为误差的主要来源而非补救手段。受此启发，我们将单轮联邦图学习重新表述为一个统计估计问题。我们提出了SPEAR（具有自适应可靠性的统计原型估计），这是一个完全免训练的框架，它直接在原始特征空间中从本地图计算拓扑平滑的类别原型。服务器随后使用样本量自适应的收缩估计器来聚合这些原型，对不可靠的本地估计进行降权处理。
tldr: 该论文提出免训练框架SPEAR，将单轮联邦图学习重新表述为统计估计问题，通过计算拓扑平滑的类别原型并使用样本量自适应的收缩估计器进行聚合，有效解决了极端非独立同分布条件下本地GNN训练导致的跨客户端表示不对齐问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SPEAR, a training-free framework that reformulates one-shot federated graph learning as a statistical estimation problem, computing topology-smoothed class prototypes locally and aggregating them with a sample-size-adaptive shrinkage estimator to address severe cross-client representation misalignment under extreme non-IID conditions.
